title: Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage — Transfer to Later Owners and Commercial-Use Terms
content:
# Transfer to Later Owners and Commercial-Use Terms

Under the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage each coverage type states whether it passes to a later owner of the vehicle, the term in months and miles that applies once the vehicle has a later owner, and whether a vehicle in commercial use receives that later-owner term even under its original owner.

## Terms of this schedule

1. **Transferable.** Yes means the coverage passes to a later owner of the vehicle; No means it does not.
2. **Later-owner term months and miles.** The term months and term miles, by make, that apply once the vehicle has a later owner. A later-owner mileage of 0 means no mileage limit.
3. **Commercial use.** Yes means a vehicle in commercial use gets the later-owner term even under its original owner; No means it does not.

## Transfer and commercial use by coverage type

| Coverage type | Transferable | Commercial use takes the later-owner term |
|---|---|---|
| Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty | No | No |
| Factory Complimentary Maintenance | Yes | No |
| Factory Basic Limited Warranty | Yes | No |
| Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty | Yes | Yes |
| Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty | Yes | No |
| Federal Emissions Performance Warranty | Yes | No |
| Safety Recall Remedy Coverage | Yes | No |

## Later-owner term months by make

| Coverage type | Toyota | Honda | Ford | Chevrolet | Hyundai |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Factory Complimentary Maintenance | 24 | 0 | 0 | 12 | 36 |
| Factory Basic Limited Warranty | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 | 60 |
| Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty | 84 | 84 | 84 | 72 | 120 |
| Federal Emissions Performance Warranty | 96 | 96 | 96 | 96 | 96 |
| Safety Recall Remedy Coverage | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |

## Later-owner term miles by make

| Coverage type | Toyota | Honda | Ford | Chevrolet | Hyundai |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty | 1,000 | 1,000 | 1,000 | 1,000 | 1,000 |
| Factory Complimentary Maintenance | 25,000 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 36,000 |
| Factory Basic Limited Warranty | 36,000 | 36,000 | 36,000 | 36,000 | 60,000 |
| Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty | 60,000 | 60,000 | 60,000 | 60,000 | 60,000 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty | 100,000 | 100,000 | 100,000 | 100,000 | 100,000 |
| Federal Emissions Performance Warranty | 80,000 | 80,000 | 80,000 | 80,000 | 80,000 |
| Safety Recall Remedy Coverage | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Points read directly from the tables

- The Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty is the only coverage type whose commercial-use entry is Yes.
- For a Hyundai, the later-owner term of the Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty is 60 months and 60,000 miles; for each of the other four makes it is also 60 months and 60,000 miles.
- The Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty is the only coverage type marked not transferable.
